note: One-passage documents and the questions asked of them. `on` must keep citing, `off` must not. Passages and questions marked device were run on the OnePlus 6T (docs/qa/android-vc21, android-vc22). de/fr/es/pt are typed with their accents and each doc's `sloppy` lists the accent-less questions kept as typing variants; zhHant-* are the zh-Hant launch locale (F363). Each de/fr/es/pt doc also carries one accent-less question whose only word in common with the passage is accented there (F367), so the lexical fold is measured by a row it can move.
